(instance Alice Person :source "Bob gave 2 apples to Alice.")

(rule
  giving-asks-the-difference
  ()
  :match (and (gave ?giver ?k ?thing ?receiver) (has ?giver ?a ?thing))
  :assert (sub ?a ?k)
  :why "{?giver} had {?a} and gave {?k}: ask {?a} less {?k}")

(rule
  giving-is-the-difference
  ()
  :match (and (gave ?giver ?k ?thing ?receiver) (has ?giver ?a ?thing) (diff-of ?a ?k ?d z))
  :assert (has ?giver ?d ?thing)
  :why "{?a} less {?k} is {?d}, so {?giver} has {?d} left")

(rule
  receiving-asks-the-sum
  ()
  :match (and (gave ?giver ?k ?thing ?receiver) (has ?receiver ?a ?thing))
  :assert (sub ?k ?a)
  :why "{?receiver} had {?a} and got {?k}: ask {?k} less {?a} (negative difference)")

(rule
  receiving-is-the-sum
  ()
  :match (and (gave ?giver ?k ?thing ?receiver) (has ?receiver ?a ?thing) (sub ?k ?a) (sub ?a ?k) (diff-of ?a ?k ?d z))
  :assert (has ?receiver ?d ?thing)
  :why "{?a} plus {?k} is {?d}, so {?receiver} has {?d} now")
